entries.title: I Built Doc Ock's Robot Claw
entries.description:
I built a custom 3d printed robot claw, with a bit of Arduino and Python. You can make one too. 

Find the files, code, and electronics parts list on my Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/omarbuilds

Mark Setrakian (the inspiration for this video): https://www.marksetrakian.com

Robotics Toolbox for Python: https://petercorke.github.io/robotics-toolbox-python

Video about my sunglasses here: https://youtu.be/Mhe74fCnzr8
